title: Impact on Vehicular Flow following New Registration and Security Measures at Pasir Panjang Wholesale Centre
what_it_is: Impact on Vehicular Flow following New Registration and Security Measures at Pasir Panjang Wholesale Centre

sections.label: Visitor Management System at PPWC
sections.summary: SFA is phasing in a Visitor Management System at Pasir Panjang Wholesale Centre to enhance safety and security and aid contact tracing.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: The Singapore Food Agency (SFA) is implementing the new Visitor Management System (VMS) at Pasir Panjang Wholesale Centre (PPWC) in phases.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: As the PPWC is an important node in our food supply chain, the VMS aims to enhance safety and security on the premises and facilitate contact tracing and site management in the event of emergencies and future pandemics.

sections.label: SFA engagement and trial kiosks
sections.summary: SFA engaged the Pasir Panjang Wholesale Centre Association and stallholders, provided trial VMS kiosks and held user demonstration practice sessions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: To facilitate a smooth transition, SFA has been engaging the Pasir Panjang Wholesale Centre Association and the stallholders, made trial VMS kiosks available at PPWC and conducted user demonstration practice sessions.

sections.label: SFA reviewing VMS operation
sections.summary: SFA will review the system's operation, consider feedback and make adjustments to minimise kinks or inconveniences as phases are implemented.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: As the various phases are implemented, SFA will review the operation of the system, take into account feedback and any adjustments that are needed to make changes so that any kinks or any inconveniences can be minimised as much as possible.

sections.label: Gradual approach starting with tenants
sections.summary: The approach is gradual, starting with tenants who must be there daily and workers permanently working there.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: So, the approach we take is going to be a gradual one.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: We start with the tenants who have to be there regularly, on a daily basis, as well as the workers who are permanently working there.

sections.label: One-year registration validity
sections.summary: Once that is done, the registration will be valid for a whole year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Once that is done, that registration will be valid for a whole year.

sections.label: Tapping sensor on gantry
sections.summary: A similar tapping sensor was mounted on the gantry, like the ERP gantry where fees are charged on the vehicle's ERP device.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Because at the normal gantry, the ERP gantry where you go to the gantry and you get the fees charged on the ERP device in your vehicle, we have mounted a similar tapping sensor on the gantry.

sections.label: Final phase public involvement
sections.summary: The final phase will involve the rest of the public.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: The final phase will then involve the rest of the public.
